title: Available formerly-issued Full callsigns (Ofcom FOI 1562825, not held)

relatedEntries.relation: the same not-held answer to a request for a list of available callsigns: Ofcom holds no discrete list of formerly-issued or unallocated callsigns, the licensing system generating them on demand.

foi-1562825-available-full-callsigns.pdf.contentsIndicative: record-only not-held response (Gloria Akinyemi, Information Rights Adviser): Ofcom holds no discrete list of formerly-issued Full callsigns available to request. Explains the Allocated/Reserved/Available status vocabulary, the default prefixes (M7 Foundation, 20 Intermediate, M0 Full) and the paper-application route (a one-off GBP 20 fee for a callsign with a non-default prefix).
